title: SCPN Dense Plasma Focus Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the dense-plasma-focus configuration within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (closed forms of the Lee model: bank normalisation, axial and radial characteristic quantities, pinch-phase terms, fast-ion-beam chain and neutron estimates, anchored to its table of twelve fitted machines), and tessellated and B-rep device models with STL, glTF and STEP exports. All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
